nameEn: Manufacture of machinery for textile, apparel and leather production
description: This class includes the manufacture of machinery used in the production of textiles, apparel and leather goods.
includes: manufacture of textile machines: machines for preparing, producing, extruding, drawing, texturing or cutting man-made textile fibres, materials or yarns
manufacture of machines for preparing textile fibres: cotton gins, bale breakers, garnets, cards, combing machines, drawing and roving machines
manufacture of weaving machines (looms), knitting machines
manufacture of machines for making knotted net, tulle and lace
manufacture of felt-making or felt-finishing machines
manufacture of dyeing, bleaching, dressing and finishing machines for textiles
manufacture of laundry-type washing, bleaching and dyeing machines for industrial use
manufacture of sewing machines for industrial use
manufacture of machines for producing or finishing leather and leather goods
excludes: manufacture of domestic sewing machines, see 2750
manufacture of domestic washing machines, see 2750
manufacture of hand tools for textile use, see 2593
